project_identity: Online Publication / Living Archive of the Tran Trong Thu Family

roles.AGY: Primary Agent (End-to-End Execution: Backend, Database, Security, API, ReBAC, System Integration, and Frontend when appropriate)
roles.Cline: Specialized Execution Resource (Visual QA, Playwright Browser Testing, CSS pixel-perfect, UI layout polish)

mobilization_policy.mobilization_trigger: Cline is mobilized only when advantageous based on the 5-dimension trade-off matrix
trade_off_dimensions: Quality & Specialized Tooling (Playwright QA / Visual inspection)

AGY: Unilateral alteration of Product Scope or Intent
Making architecture decisions reserved for Tuấn
Changing Data Policies, Privacy Boundaries, or Ontology without Human Gate
Production deployment or destructive operations without Human Gate
Cline: Backend and Database code modification (server/, database/)
Redefining genealogy ontology or IA canonicalization

human_approval_gates.GATE_01: Approval of security containment code diffs
human_approval_gates.GATE_02: Approval of database physical backup and person_media restoration
human_approval_gates.GATE_03: Approval of UI System vNEXT and Browser QA test reports
human_approval_gates.GATE_04: Approval of ReBAC policies and Recognition vs Disclosure boundaries
human_approval_gates.GATE_05: Approval of full E2E staging integration test results
human_approval_gates.GATE_06: Approval of V1.0 release tag and live production deployment
